items.t: Innodata Lifts 2026 Sales Growth Outlook to 42%: What's Next?
items.sum: INOD raises its 2026 revenue growth outlook to at least 42% on strong AI demand and hyperscaler deals, but customer transitions and stock weakness pose risks.

items.t: Innodata (INOD) Faces A Valuation Test As Earnings And Selling Pressure Collide

items.t: Is Innodata Worth Buying as AI Growth Collides With Premium Valuation?
items.sum: INOD's AI growth, hyperscaler wins and strong cash position support its outlook, but a premium valuation and customer concentration raise execution risks.

items.t: INOD Drops 15.5% in a Week as Program Loss and Margin Risks Resurface
items.sum: Innodata shares fall 15.5% as a terminated program creates a $12 million revenue gap, raising concerns over customer concentration, timing and margins.

items.t: Can Innodata Sustain 42% Growth After a $12 Million Program Wind-Down?
items.sum: INOD raises its 2026 revenue-growth outlook to 42% despite a $12 million program wind-down, with new hyperscaler wins offering growth potential but margin pressure and customer concentration posing risks.

items.t: Innodata Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Growth Outlook and AI Expansion
items.sum: INOD raises its 2026 revenue growth outlook to at least 42% as major AI contract wins and robotics expansion offset a $12M fourth-quarter revenue headwind.
